title: Make bin/brain run under the engine's venv, not the system python3
notes: Found 2026-11-23 installing a fresh instance on a second macOS machine (Darwin 27.2, uv 0.11, pnpm 11) following syntopica AGENTS.md.

bin/brain is '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and re-execs sys.executable. On stock macOS the first python3 on PATH is /usr/bin/python3 (3.9), so every command dies at import: tools/graph/resolve_bare_target.py uses 'str | None' -> TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |. pyproject requires 3.12 but the launcher never selects the venv that 'uv sync' built.
Workaround in use: a ~/.local/bin/brain wrapper that execs engines/brain/.venv/bin/python tools/index/brain_cli.py (same as the MBP wrapper).
done_when: engines/brain/bin/brain doctor passes on a machine whose PATH python3 is 3.9 (prefer .venv/bin/python next to the checkout, fall back to 'uv run --project')
